summary.text: Houston Brignano is the Republican nominee for California's 36th District. A South Bay native and Marine veteran of two Iraq tours, he is described by the Daily Bruin as a technology executive. He placed second in the June 2026 primary and is running on federal spending transparency, housing and healthcare costs, and AI-focused job training.

paragraphs.text: Houston Brignano says he is a South Bay native, born and raised there.
He says he joined the Marine Corps right out of high school and deployed for two tours in Iraq, an experience he cites as shaping his focus on government accountability.
The Daily Bruin describes him as a technology executive who has advocated for an immigration system that prioritizes American-born citizens in the job market and for AI-focused job training programs.

Brignano says he lives in the South Bay with his wife and three daughters, whom the family homeschools, and that he serves on the boards of a homeschool co-op in Redondo Beach and a church in Old Torrance.
He placed second in the June 2, 2026 nonpartisan primary with 15.3% of the vote (35,851 votes), advancing to the general election against Rep. Ted Lieu.

sources.title: Ted Lieu, Houston Brignano win 36th district representative primary
